# DomDimaBot

DomDimaBot is a Twitch chatbot for live-channel moderation, custom commands, automation, analytics, and text-to-speech.

## Documentation

- [Docs](https://docs.domdimabot.com/)
- [Getting started](https://docs.domdimabot.com/getting-started/)
- [Commands](https://docs.domdimabot.com/commands/)
- [Advanced commands (AST)](https://docs.domdimabot.com/commands/advanced/)
- [Text-to-speech (TTS)](https://docs.domdimabot.com/tts/)
